outcome: Maternal outcomes (postpartum hemoglobin levels, oxytocin use, labor duration, overall maternal complications)
Staff perceptions (usability, feasibility, improved decision-making, acceptability, satisfaction)
cohort: The study involved 120 parturients, with 60 monitored using a standard partograph and 60 monitored with the WHO Labour Care Guide (LCG).
finding: The WHO Labour Care Guide (LCG) is a feasible and user-friendly tool that enhances intrapartum care, potentially reducing unnecessary cesarean sections and improving maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: LCG use was associated with an increase in normal vaginal deliveries (70% vs. 56.7%) and a reduction in cesarean sections (25% vs. 38.3%).
